card.name: Numbers in decrease or reversal comparisons
card.fires_on: Numbers, units and percent signs inside a table or sentence about a decrease, a drop or a fall against placebo or baseline. It fires where the text points in the opposite direction, as in "1 fewer case" or "↓22%".

modes.label: Fewer cases vs placebo
modes.description: The number 1 in the age-group table of cases that decrease compared to placebo.

modes.label: Arrow ranges for drug interactions
modes.description: Percent figures in a range with down and up arrows in an interaction table.

modes.label: Small changes vs placebo
modes.description: Units or percent signs after small changes in measurements that are compared with another group.
